label: Free cash flow (FCF)
short_definition: Cash from operations less capital expenditure.

label: Free cash flow margin
short_definition: Free cash flow as a share of revenue.

label: Net change in cash
short_definition: The period's total cash movement across operating, investing, and financing activities.
formula_description: Cash from Operations + Cash from Investing + Cash from Financing -- the period's own bottom-line cash movement, distinct from net_cash (a balance-sheet POSITION: Cash - Total Debt).

label: Free cash flow per share
short_definition: Trailing twelve-month free cash flow divided by shares outstanding.
formula_description: Free Cash Flow (TTM) / Shares Outstanding. Computed in expanded_metrics.py.
